headline: Large institutional investors sold $11 billion of US single stocks last week, mostly tech shares.
score_reason: Bank flow data from one note, carried by a finance site; pool score 5 kept.
importance_line: It matters most to investors in individual tech stocks, since large funds have been selling them for two weeks, though this is one bank's flow data and hedge funds and retail investors were net buyers.
summary: Seeking Alpha reports, citing a note by Bank of America strategist Jill Carey Hall, that institutional investors sold $11 billion of US single stocks last week, the third-largest such outflow in the bank's data history. Technology shares led the selling, while investors put $3.2 billion into equity exchange-traded funds (ETFs, baskets of shares that trade like one stock) for a 15th straight week.
